candidates.change_summary: Require that only the zero address can call withdrawAll instead of the owner, changing who can trigger the transfer.
Require that the caller equals the recipient instead of the owner, so only recipients can withdraw to themselves.
Replace the transfer with a call that forwards no gas and checks success, reverting on failure (alters transfer behavior and potential reentrancy semantics).
Swap the order: zero out the contract balance by sending 0 value before transferring full balance (introduces a different executed statement order).
Remove the require guard so anyone can call withdrawAll, changing who can trigger transfers.
